correctness.rationale: With I positive two exponentials, N=2TI-E, S'=N/(2T^(3/2)), N(0)=0 and N(infinity)<0. Multiplying N' by exp(lambda T) yields linear plus a linear-exponential term with second derivative equal to a nonzero exponential times a linear polynomial, hence <=one zero. Rolle twice bounds positive N' zeros by 3; N(0)=0 bounds distinct positive N zeros by 3. A third strict local maximum would require >=5 positive critical points. Four exact rational intervals for lambda=1, mu=30, a=1,b=5 certify +,-,+,- at 1/20,1/8,1/3,1, yielding exactly two strict maxima. One exponential has unique maximum by sign of N'. Checker included.

No field calibration or global instrument relevance is claimed.
